image_description: Two colorful, patchwork-style baby bibs lying flat on a white surface. The bib on the left features horizontal stripes of pink, orange, and purple fabric against a grey textured background. The bib on the right has a complex design with a red patterned section, a blue section with cartoonish figures, and a large grey area with a faint white graphic. Both have dark blue binding around the edges.
